acceptanceCriteria: A push to main whose commit a successful merge_group run of CI already tested in full skips only the root race invocation, as AFP-V0-024 does for a pull-request result; any other case, including a failed, cancelled, partial or differently-sharded queue run, runs FULL.

tools/ci-reuse-plan tests cover the admitted merge_group case and each refusal, AFP-V0-024 is amended in the same change, and one hosted main-push run after a queue merge is retained showing REUSE with the queue run id.
body: Filed 2026-10-04 while adding the merge_group trigger (pull request 552, AFP-V0-026). With a merge queue on main, each merge runs the complete suite on the queue commit and then again on the main push of that same commit, about an hour of four shards each time. AFP-V0-024 reuse does not match: tools/ci-reuse-plan admits only runs with event pull_request whose head_sha is the second parent of the pushed merge commit, and the docs-plan reuse step in .github/workflows/ci.yml queries only event=pull_request for that parent. The queue run has event merge_group and head_sha equal to the pushed commit itself, so the tree is identical by construction. Expected: the main push reuses the queue run of the same commit. Not yet observed on a hosted run: the queue is not enabled, so whether a merge_group run retains the same per-shard tested-tree records (the record step is currently conditioned on pull_request) and whether the pushed commit id equals the queue commit id under merge method merge must be confirmed first; the record step needs to run for merge_group. Keep every failure path FULL. Related: V1-0717, V1-0752, V1-0728, CORE-GITHUB-MERGE-QUEUE-COMPATIBILITY-1.
title: ci: reuse the merge-queue run of the same commit on the main push
